name: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited

timeline.x: [General Updates] Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange about intimation of receipt of listing approvals for 3,00,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 each, allotted pursuant to conversion of equivalent warrants issued on preferential basis.

[Sale or disposal] Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board has approved to enter into a Business Transfer Agreement ( BTA ) with Emkay Wealth Advisory Limited, for the carve-out and transfer of the Wealth Management Business of the Company, which includes the distribution business, referral business and other relevant business activities pertaining to wealth Management ( Wealth Management Business ), on a going concern basis through a slump sale on such terms and conditions as detailed in the BTA.

[Acquisition] EMKAY: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board has approved an investment in the Equity Shares of Emkay Capital Private Limited (ECPL), a wholly owned subsidiary, of amount not exceeding Rs. 30 Crores by way of subscription to Rights Issue of Equity Shares of ECPL having face value of Rs. 10 each, at par, in one or more tranches.

[General Updates] Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of Receipt of Listing Approval from BSE Limited for 1,00,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 Each, allotted pursuant to Conversion of Equivalent Warrants Issued on a Preferential Basis.
